sources.name: Høytorp fort
sources.finding: Named historic military-area object with representative point at 59.56228, 11.34038.

sources.name: Høytorp fort
sources.finding: Official military-estate history identifies establishment 012501 as a land fort, the main fortress in Fossumstrøket and part of the Glomma Line.

sources.name: Høytorp fort
sources.finding: Official current site interpretation documents construction in 1912–1918, battles in April 1940, protection in 2001, municipal ownership from 2003, 426 dekar and 41 buildings.

sources.name: Høytorp Fort
sources.finding: The site association documents the central mountain complex, turret guns, museum, restoration work, guided visits and current use as cultural monument and recreation area.

sources.name: Omvisning
sources.finding: The guided route passes through the central mountain complex, turret, highest viewpoint and fortress museum and is approximately 1.2 km long, about 0.5 km underground.

rejectedCandidates.reason: Same-name tourism-information point rather than the fort area.
Important central component and viewpoint, but only one part of the multi-part fort.
Visitor institutions within the fort, not substitutes for the whole historic installation.
Approximately 1,082 metres southwest of the named fort area and not tied to an identifiable fort object.

representationLimits: The marker represents the named main fort area rather than one building, gun position, museum or information point.
The 420 m gameplay radius covers the central fort and important visitor elements but not the complete 426-decare site.
The radius is not a legal protection, property, building or complete fortification boundary.
Trøgstad fort, bridge galleries and other Fossumstrøket components remain separate sites.
